title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
summary: Miserly Ebenezer Scrooge is visited on Christmas Eve by the ghost of his dead business partner and three spirits. Each shows him a different part of his life and what may lie ahead.
readIf: you want a short, warm, atmospheric classic to read around the holidays.
skipIf: you dislike sentiment or a clearly stated moral.

pairings.reason: A longer, darker Dickens novel with a similar concern for the poor and neglected.
Another cosy, old-fashioned classic with a strong sense of home and hospitality.
